newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Guilder rates steady in becalmed trade.
newsitem.headline: Guilder rates steady in becalmed trade.

text.p: Guilder rates stayed pinned to the previous day's levels in slack Tuesday trade with the market eagerly looking out for fresh impetus.
Overnight guilders were trading at an almost unchanged 2.94-3.00 percent, while other rates also marked time at Monday's levels, dealers said.
Dealers said prices of the current Dutch Treasury Certificate programmes discouraged primary activity, but added there was no trade in the secondary market either.
The guilder was quoted at 112.58 per 100 marks, down a touch from Monday's 112.57 fixing.
